West Hub Canteen

 

The West Hub Canteen is the place to go for an exciting range of hot and cold food.

The menu includes main meals, offering plenty of delicious gluten-free and plant-based options. The weekly menu is published below.

The Canteen serves breakfast, lunch and afternoon snacks. 

Week commencing 21st September 2026

Monday

  • Vegetable Jalfrezi, raita, garlic & coriander naan
  • Big Mac burrito
  • Thai green chicken breast, coconut & lemongrass sauce, stir fried beans
  • Garlic & citrus mojo pork steak with Cuban slaw

Tuesday

  • Vegan empanadas, green goddess sauce
  • Gnocchi, pomodoro sauce, parmesan, baby herbs
  • Nut free chicken satay, radish salad, toasted coconut
  • Pork, roasted fennel & blue cheese lasagne

Wednesday

  • Mushroom wings, pilaf rice, buffalo sauce
  • Enchiladas baked in San Marzano tomato sauce
  • Angry roast chicken, tomato butter sauce
  • Gua bao bun, Asian slaw

Thursday

  • Moussaka, garlic & herb slice
  • Veggie meatball biryani
  • Chicken with rosemary & parmesan  crumb, roasted tomato & watercress
  • Lemongrass & sticky onion pork burger

 Friday

  • Roasted sweet potato burrito, black bean sauce, Jalapeno salsa
  • Pea & halloumi fritters, grilled asparagus, orange & chilli drizzle
  • Hunters style chicken topped with melted cheese & crispy bacon
  • Battered haddock, lemon homemade tartare sauce
